label: Representation cases
title: Three executable cases of representation failure and repair
summary: A wrong candidate law, a genuine factor obstruction, and a finite-ring/full-line gap, each with an executable certificate.
takeaway: Distinguish law choice, erased information and domain before choosing a repair.

label: Causal retention
title: What Rule 110 must remember at a fixed asynchronous interface
summary: All 63 nontrivial quotients of the twelve-state Nakamura interface fail when current/phase readout, radius one and atomic semantics are fixed.
takeaway: Whole-field necessary checks can miss local implementation obstructions; this restricted bound permits other eight-state protocols.
